title: Health Insurance Renewal Notice
source: Your health insurance coverage will expire on 2026-12-15. To keep your benefits, renew by paying ETB 500 before the deadline. Bring your ID card and previous insurance card to the nearest health office. If you miss the deadline, your coverage will stop.

en.summary: Your health insurance is ending soon. You must renew it to keep your benefits.

actions.step: Pay ETB 500 to keep your coverage.
Bring your ID card and insurance card to the health office.

eligibility: People whose health insurance coverage is currently active.
howToApply: Pay ETB 500 at the nearest health office before 2026-12-15.

am.summary: የጤና ኢንሹራንስዎ በ2026-12-15 ያበቃል። ጥቅምዎን ለማቆየት አሁን ማደስ ይኖርብዎታል።

actions.step: የመታወቂያ ካርድዎንና የቀድሞውን የኢንሹራንስ ካርድ ይዘው በአቅራቢያዎ ወደሚገኝ የጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።

eligibility: የጤና ኢንሹራንስ ሽፋና አሁን የሚኖር ሰዎች።
howToApply: ከ2026-12-15 በፊት ETB 500 በእጅጉ ያለው የጤና ጣቢያ ይክፈሉ።

om.summary: Inshuraansiin fayyaa keessan guyyaa 2026-12-15 tti dhumata. Faayidaa keessan eeguuf amma haaromsuu qabdu.
